Build monitoring and retry mechanisms for failed or delayed partner API transactions. 4. Agentic AI and Voice AI Design and deploy AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer interactions. Build AI workflows for lead qualification, document collection, application assistance, reminders and customer support. Integrate speech-to-text, text-to-speech, LLMs, telephony platforms and CRM systems. Develop AI agents using tool calling, workflow orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and appropriate guardrails. Use AI for document extraction, application data validation, customer-query resolution and operational automation. Implement human escalation, conversation audit trails, consent controls, evaluation frameworks and monitoring. The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration . Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs . Good understanding of SQL and relational databases ( PostgreSQL/MySQL ); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred. Agentic AI / GenAI Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. Understanding of agentic AI architecture , including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows. Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen . Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs. Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search . Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent . Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs . Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations. Experience building multi-agent systems . Cloud & DevOps Experience with Docker and containerized applications. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments. Education & Soft Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field . Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong communication and documentation skills. Good to Have Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n . Experience with document AI : extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents. Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms. Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka . Experience with Kubernetes . Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models. Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization . Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS . What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions , not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services , preferably deployed in production. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law, and we provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. These principles apply across all of our employment practices. Excited About This Opportunity? We’d love to hear from you! Apply through the Sirion Careers page and follow the steps listed there. 4-7 Yrs Fullstack Development, Python, Senior, Software, Full Stack, Stack, Development

An SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is a senior technology executive responsible for leading enterprise AI initiatives from strategy through execution and value realization. The role provides leadership for AI engineering organizations and serves as the accountable owner for AI platforms, intelligent automation capabilities, machine learning solutions, and emerging AI technologies that support business transformation. The position focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes through AI while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and governance. The Senior Director is responsible for setting the technical and business direction for AI programs, establishing multi-year roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and aligning technology execution with organizational goals. They work closely with business leaders, product teams, operations partners, architecture groups, and executive leadership to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, reduce cost, enhance customer experiences, and create new capabilities. Success is measured not only by technology delivery but also by adoption, operational impact, productivity gains, and financial value creation. As a people leader, the role oversees a team of engineering leaders, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, and platform specialists distributed across onshore and offshore locations. Responsibilities include organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, hiring, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning. The Senior Director creates an environment of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence while building a solid leadership bench capable of scaling enterprise AI capabilities. From a technology perspective, this leader owns the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions, including platform architecture, model deployment, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, production operations, observability, and reliability engineering. The role ensures that AI capabilities are developed as reusable enterprise assets rather than isolated solutions, enabling faster adoption and greater return on investment across multiple business domains. The position carries significant accountability for Responsible AI, compliance, security, and risk management. The Senior Director ensures that all AI solutions comply with governance requirements, regulatory obligations, ethical AI principles, privacy standards, and operational controls. They establish processes for model monitoring, performance measurement, incident management, human oversight, and continuous improvement to maintain trust and reliability at enterprise scale. The role requires solid executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders across the organization. The Senior Director regularly communicates strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes to executives while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. They act as the bridge between technology and business organizations, ensuring that AI investments are translated into meaningful operational and financial results. Ultimately, an SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is expected to provide broad organizational leadership, own enterprise-scale AI platforms and programs, drive adoption and value realization, build high-performing teams, ensure governance and operational excellence, and serve as the accountable leader for delivering transformative AI capabilities that advance the organization's strategic objectives. jobs.description: About Us: CLOUDSUFI, a Google Cloud Premier Partner, is a global leading provider of data-driven digital transformation across cloud-based enterprises. All qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and national origin status. We provide equal opportunities in employment, advancement, and all other areas of our workplace. Please explore more at https://www.cloudsufi.com/ About the role Role Summary: Software Engineer, Internal AI Products A Software Engineer who builds the tools this company runs on. You build agent loops, and the loops build the solutions. You work towards a Company Brain that anyone here can ask.35 years’ experience • Reports to the CFO • THE KEY SKILL: You build the agent loops that build the solutions. You will not write every automation by hand. You build the loops that write them. Ship a prototype every week. You ship something every day. You’ll be building a Company Brain with access control. One system that holds what the company knows about finance,delivery and people. Anyone can ask it a question. Each person sees only what they are cleared to see. One hard filter. If you cannot write and debug production code, and have not done it before, please do not apply. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: Work the backlog: You pick items off a live, ranked backlog. You learn each function by building inside it. There is no discovery phase. What you learn goes back into the backlog and changes what comes next. Build the product: You design, build and ship tools that people use every day. Reconciliation, MIS, the deal desk,quote to cash, or whatever the real bottleneck turns out to be. You choose the tools and frameworks. Wire the data: Connect the systems each team already uses, so that the same number means the same thing everywhere. Make it visible: You build live dashboards and alerts that leaders read on their own, instead of asking someone for a report. Keep it running: You own uptime and accuracy for everything you build. Anything that touches money or people needs a person in the loop. THE STACK: Build with: Python and TypeScript. You write production code. Frontier model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, with tool calling and structured output. At least one agent framework. MCP to connect agents to internal systems.Postgres and pgvector, or something similar, for retrieval. You deploy on GCP, and you debug your own work. Work in agents daily: Claude Code, Cursor or something like them, as the way you write code every day. You should have a clear view on how to run the loop, and on when a person has to step in. Connect to: The systems we already run on for accounting, CRM, hiring and IT support, along with Google Workspace.Most of the work is getting them to agree with each other. Check what you ship: Anything that produces a number needs a way to catch it going quietly wrong. Test sets, regression checks, and alerts on the output as well as on the job. WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE: Something you built is running by week two, and someone is using it. • By day 90, time spent on reconciliation or reporting is down by a number you can defend to the CFO. • Every tool you ship has a named owner who is still using it 60 days later. That is the measure that counts. • Leaders stop asking for numbers, because they can already see them. • By the end of your first year, a first version of the Company Brain answers real questions about Finance, and each person who asks sees only what they are cleared to see. WHO THIS IS FOR: You have built products: 3 to 5 years at a software product company, on a product with real users at scale. That means 100k+ monthly active users, or heavy daily use by a large enterprise customer base. You have owned code in production, in front of real users, long after it shipped. • You ship alone: You are comfortable as the only engineer in the room, and the only person on call for what you built. • You work out new ground fast : A domain you do not know is interesting to you. You start without waiting for a spec or an expert. • You are fluent with agents: One person cannot cover a whole company by hand. You use agent loops heavily and youare good at it. • You write and speak clearly: Half this job is pulling a process out of a finance or delivery lead and giving it back to them correctly. You work remotely, so this matters a great deal. HOW WE WILL ASSESS: • A design problem: Live. We give you a function of the B2B company, and you design the system for it. We watch how you break down a domain you do not know, how you size it, and what you leave out on purpose. • A build exercise: Live and screen-shared, on your own setup, with your own agents. You build the way you normally build. We watch how you run the loop, when you step in, and what you decide to skip. • Your work and your questions: We talk about what you have shipped before. You ask us whatever you want. Communication is not a separate round. All three sessions are live, and how clearly you explain your thinking is part of how we judge you. WHERE IT LEADS You report to the CEO and CFO from your first day. Your charter covers the whole company. Nothing sits between you and production. Very few engineering jobs offer all three at once, and that is why this one exists. In 18 months you will know how this company really runs: the data, the money, and the gaps between teams. The rolethen changes shape to fit whatever the biggest open problem is by then. Note : Interested candidates can share their CVs at lishta.jain@cloudsufi.com . 3-6 Yrs System Design, Claude Code, Aiml, Full Stack, Workflow Automation, TypeScript, Ai Builder, API
